name: CodeFaeries Store Sentinel: Activity Log for WooCommerce
author: Long Watch Studio - Code Faeries

sections.description:
Store Sentinel is a WooCommerce activity log. It records when an order is trashed, permanently deleted, refunded or changes status, when a product is trashed or deleted or its stock changes, when a WooCommerce setting or a payment gateway is changed, when a store manager logs in or fails to, and when a plugin is activated or deactivated, then shows these events in one chronological feed.

For each event you see who did it (user, role, display name), where the change came from (admin, REST API, WP-CLI, cron or AJAX) and which plugin was behind it. When an order disappears, a payment method is switched off or a price setting changes, you know what happened, when, and by whom.

Support | Store Sentinel Pro

Free WooCommerce activity log features

What it records

  • Order trashed (warning) – an order moved to the trash
  • Order deleted (critical) – an order permanently deleted
  • Order status changed (info) – for example from processing to completed
  • Product trashed (warning) – a product moved to the trash
  • Product deleted (critical) – a product permanently deleted
  • Order meta deleted (warning) – order metadata removed; off by default, turn it on in the General tab
  • Order refunded (warning) – a full or partial refund, with its amount and reason
  • Stock changed (info) – a stock quantity changed outside an order: product edit, quick edit, import, REST API or another plugin
  • Store setting changed (warning) – a WooCommerce setting changed, with its old and new value; passwords, keys and tokens are masked
  • Payment gateway changed (critical) – a payment method turned on or off, or its settings changed
  • Store manager login (info) and failed login (warning) – on accounts that can manage WooCommerce only; failed logins are recorded at most once per account every 15 minutes
  • Plugin activated (info) or deactivated (warning) – a deactivated payment, shipping or security plugin changes your store

Find what happened

  • Chronological activity feed – every recorded WooCommerce event in one timeline, newest first
  • Severity levels – info, warning or critical, for quick visual scanning
  • Filters – by event type, severity and date range, with Today / 7 days / 30 days presets, free-text search, user ID and object ID
  • Event details – order totals, old and new status, product info, the source of the change, the plugin behind it, the acting user, and an order status history that merges Store Sentinel events with WooCommerce order notes
  • Dashboard widget – today’s activity at a glance on the WordPress dashboard
  • WP-CLI – list and read events from the command line with wp codefaeries-store-sentinel events list and events get, with the same filters as the feed

Built for WooCommerce stores

  • HPOS compatible – built for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage from day one, with a fallback for stores on the legacy order storage
  • Privacy-first activity log – customer emails are partially masked, client IPs are stored only as a salted hash, and no data leaves your site
  • GDPR tools – personal-data exporter, eraser and a suggested privacy policy section
  • Retention you choose – a daily cleanup removes events older than the retention period, from 7 days to unlimited (7 days by default)
  • Multisite – per-site activation, each site with its own events table and settings
  • Accessible – focus-trapped event modal, ARIA live regions, keyboard navigation
  • Developer friendly – filters and actions for every event, severity and query

Store Sentinel Pro

Anomaly detection, email alerts (immediate, hourly or daily digest), webhook notifications, scheduled email reports, advanced filters (source, object type, saved per-user presets), CSV and JSON export, a read-only REST API, the choice of roles that can read the log, Discord notifications and more event types (customers, coupons, shipping) are part of Store Sentinel Pro, distributed separately from codefaeries.com. The free plugin already offers unlimited retention.

More about Store Sentinel Pro

Do you like Store Sentinel?

A review on wordpress.org helps other store owners find it: leave a review. Thank you.

Privacy

Store Sentinel records WooCommerce store events (order/product trashes,
deletions and status changes, refunds, stock, store setting and payment gateway
changes, plugin activations) and the logins and failed logins of accounts that
can manage the store, to a custom table in your own database. Customer logins
are not recorded. Customer
emails captured in event context are partially masked, and client IP addresses,
when IP tracking is enabled, are stored only as a one-way SHA-256 hash salted
with your site’s WordPress salt. The raw IP is never written to the database.

Two pieces of data about the person who acted are stored in clear: the display
name, login and role of the logged-in user behind the event, snapshotted so the
history survives that account being deleted; and, when IP tracking is enabled,
the browser user agent string, truncated to 255 characters. Both are exposed
through the personal-data exporter and removed by the eraser.

Store Sentinel does not phone home and does not send any data to external
services. All event data stays in your own database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the codefaeries-store-sentinel folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Navigate to Store Sentinel in the admin menu to view the activity feed.
sections.faq:
Is Store Sentinel free?

Yes. Everything listed under “Free WooCommerce activity log features” is free, with no time limit, including unlimited retention. Store Sentinel Pro, distributed separately, adds anomaly detection, email alerts, webhooks and Discord notifications, scheduled reports, CSV and JSON export, a REST API, role-based access and more event types.

What does Store Sentinel record?

Orders trashed, permanently deleted, refunded or changing status; products trashed or permanently deleted and stock changes made outside an order; WooCommerce settings and payment gateway changes; logins and failed logins on store manager accounts; plugins activated or deactivated; and, if you turn it on, order metadata removed. Each event gets a severity: info, warning or critical. Choose which types are recorded on the Settings, General tab.

Can I see who deleted an order or a product?

Yes. Each event shows the user who acted (display name, login and role), the source of the change (admin, REST API, WP-CLI, cron or AJAX) and the plugin behind it. The user details are kept even if that account is deleted later.

How do I find a specific event?

Filter the feed by event type, severity and date range (Today, 7 days, 30 days or your own dates), search by text, or by user ID and object ID. Click an event to see its full details.

Can I see the status history of an order?

Yes. The event details show a status history that merges Store Sentinel events with the WooCommerce order notes.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Store Sentinel is built for WooCommerce and tested against WooCommerce 7.9 and later. If WooCommerce is not active, the plugin shows an admin notice and stays inactive; it does not check which version of WooCommerce is installed.

Is it compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Store Sentinel is built HPOS-native: it works through WooCommerce order objects and HPOS-compatible hooks. On stores still using the legacy post-based order storage it falls back to reading wp_postmeta.

How long are events kept?

7 days by default. Change the retention period on the Settings, Data & Privacy tab, from 7 days to unlimited. A daily cleanup removes older events to keep the database lean.

Does Store Sentinel send my store data anywhere?

No. It does not phone home and sends no data to external services. Events are stored in a custom table in your own database. Customer emails are partially masked and client IPs, when IP tracking is on, are stored only as a salted one-way hash.

What happens to my data if I deactivate the plugin?

By default, deactivation only clears the cron schedule: all event data is kept, and reactivating gives you your full history back. Data is removed only when you delete (uninstall) the plugin, or on deactivation if you turn on “Delete all event data when the plugin is deactivated” on Settings, Data & Privacy (off by default).

Does it work on multisite?

Yes, with per-site activation. Each site has its own events table and settings. Uninstall cleans up all sites in batches.

Can I extend it with custom events?

Yes. Use the codefaeries_store_sentinel_event_data filter to change event data before it is recorded, or codefaeries_store_sentinel_should_record to skip events. The codefaeries_store_sentinel_event_recorded action fires after each event is stored.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1 – 2026-11-20

  • New: WooCommerce setting changes are recorded with their old and new value; passwords, keys and tokens are masked.
  • New: payment gateways turned on or off, or whose settings change, are recorded as critical events.
  • New: stock quantity changes made outside an order are recorded with the old and new quantity.
  • New: refunds are recorded with their amount, reason and payment method.
  • New: logins and failed logins on store manager accounts are recorded; customer logins are not.
  • New: plugin activations and deactivations are recorded.
  • New: read the activity log from WP-CLI with wp codefaeries-store-sentinel events list and events get.
  • Improved: the new event types are turned on after the update, on new and existing stores; turn any of them off on the Settings, General tab.
  • Improved: the help tab and the suggested privacy policy text describe the new events.

1.0.9 – 2026-11-20

  • Improved: event types added by Store Sentinel Pro show their name in the activity log, the event details and the type filter. No change to features or settings.

1.0.8 – 2026-11-20

  • Fixed: the WordPress version the plugin is tested with is declared once, in the readme, as the plugin directory now requires. No change to features or settings.

1.0.7 – 2026-11-20

  • Improved: the plugin is renamed “CodeFaeries Store Sentinel: Activity Log for WooCommerce” and its wordpress.org page is rewritten. No change to features or settings.

1.0.6 – 2026-10-05

  • Improved: the bundled admin toolkit is updated to its latest release. No change to features or settings.
  • Compatibility: tested up to WordPress 7.1.

1.0.5 – 2026-10-02

  • Improved: released together with Store Sentinel Pro 1.0.5, whose settings fixes need this version. Nothing changes in the free features.

1.0.4 – 2026-10-02

  • Fixed: a retention period that is no longer offered (for example 180 or 365 days after Store Sentinel Pro is deactivated or its licence lapses) is kept when the settings are saved, instead of dropping to 7 days and letting the next cleanup delete older events.
  • Fixed: choosing “Unlimited” retention shows its warning straight away, not only after saving.
  • Fixed: the review request no longer appears right after activation; it waits the intended 14 days.
  • Fixed: the “Get Support” and Store Sentinel Pro links lead to pages that exist.
  • Improved: the Pro panel inside the plugin describes exactly what Store Sentinel Pro adds.

1.0.3 – 2026-07-03

  • Fixed: permanently deleted orders were not being recorded because the deletion listener used an outdated hook name; order deletions are now captured correctly on HPOS stores.

1.0.2 – 2026-05-18

  • Improved: Store Sentinel is now a focused free plugin — anomaly detection, email alerts, webhooks and scheduled reports moved to the separately distributed Store Sentinel Pro, with documented hooks so Pro builds cleanly on the free version.
  • Compatibility: “Tested up to” bumped to WordPress 7.0.
  • Code quality: passes WordPress Plugin Check cleanly.
  • New: filter to exclude specific plugin slugs from event source detection (helps when third-party plugins clutter the backtrace).

1.0.1

  • Internal: release packaging refreshed and CHANGELOG.md consolidated into this changelog.

1.0.0

First public release. Store Sentinel is a WooCommerce early-warning system: a chronological feed of critical store actions.

  • Live activity feed with filters (event type, severity, date range) and pagination.
  • Tracks orders (trashed, deleted, status changes, meta removal) and products (trashed, deleted).
  • Severity levels — info, warning, critical — with a detail modal showing full context.
  • Records the source of each action (Admin, REST API, WP-CLI, Cron, AJAX) and the actor (user, role, display name).
  • Settings page for event toggles, retention, privacy, and data management.
  • Dashboard widget showing today’s activity.
  • Daily automatic retention cleanup (7-day default, configurable).
  • HPOS-native (WooCommerce 7.9+).
  • Multisite-aware install and uninstall.
  • Accessibility: focus-trapped modal, ARIA live regions, keyboard navigation.
  • Extensible by developers via filters and actions.
